pattern: SELECT .+ FROM\s+[A-Za-z0-9_\s]+  JOIN [A-Za-z0-9_\s]+ ON \w+ =\w+  GROUP BY \w+  ORDER BY COUNT\(DISTINCT\s+\w+ \) DESC LIMIT 1
correction: Replace the part 'COUNT(DISTINCT \w+)' with 'count(\*)' and ensure that the count is based on the correct column in the JOIN statement.

metadata.description: This rule identifies SQL queries where the aggregation function counts distinct values of a column instead of the total count. It provides a correction to fix this error.
